question: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:1. Reducing dependence on fossil fuels is essential to combat climate change.2. Transitioning to renewable energy sources plays a vital role in this process.3. This transition lowers emissions and generates employment opportunities.4. Energy-efficient policies further reduce overall consumption.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins by emphasizing the need to reduce dependence on fossil fuels to combat climate change. 
 
• **Sentence 1 is the first sentence** as it introduces the primary idea: 
 
 
• "Reducing dependence on fossil fuels is essential to combat climate change."
